data.narrative:
Flapping Airplanes is a private AI & Software company founded by Benjamin Spector, Asher Spector, and Aidan Smith. The company operates within a defined peer universe of 9 comparable entities: 1 public (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private firms including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition. Stage and current valuation remain undisclosed, limiting precision in peer categorization.

The peer-median method, typically the primary triangulation approach, is not applicable here. The analysis identified 12 same-sector peers within AI & Software but found zero companies meeting narrower filters—same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial noise and misrepresent the target's positioning. No alternative triangulation methods were documented as viable given the data constraints.

This analysis cannot support a specific valuation range without either: (1) disclosure of Flapping Airplanes' funding stage, recent fundraise, or reported metrics; or (2) willingness to use public-market PLTR multiples as a proxy, which carries material basis-of-comparison risk. The 8-company private peer set exists but lacks sufficient homogeneity in stage or scale for meaningful median-based inference. Further diligence—including stage confirmation and revenue or user metrics—is required before quantitative synthesis is warranted.
